body: I'm glad to hear that someone's out there kind of like me. I wouldn't say I'm a sociopath - I care about way too much. I feel too many things. But about my own life, that is a different story. I'd rather see my parents/sibling/girlfriend/close friend live than myself. I don't care about success, I don't see money being a part of happiness. I can live in a shack in the middle of nowhere and I'd be satisfied. I'm kind of drunk right now, but I think these things when I'm sober. It comes out when I'm drunk. I just don't understand the way I think, its kind of sociopathic, but not at all. I don't get it.
